**3. Industry Overview:**

The financial technology (FinTech) sector in India has experienced significant growth, driven by increased digital adoption and supportive regulatory frameworks. The account aggregator ecosystem is emerging as a pivotal component, facilitating secure and consent-based data sharing between financial institutions and consumers. **4. Business Description:**

Subex Account Aggregator Services offers a platform that enables individuals and businesses to consolidate financial information from multiple accounts into a single interface. This service addresses the market need for streamlined financial data management, enhancing user experience and financial decision-making. The company primarily serves clients within India, focusing on both individual consumers and financial institutions.
